text: In that dark corner unreachable to the surface world, where monsters and demons hid in the darkness, a genius was born from that same darkness after a rainy night...

In pursuit of victory and so-called perfection, on a rainy night that resembled the day he came into the world, the genius walked into the mansion of the madman. The demons met, and so began the night that would soon become a legend...
{character:???}Wake up... Wake up... Wake up... Washizu...
{character:Iwao Washizu}Ouch... That hurts...
{character:???}Wa-Wait... He's a senior, after all. I don't think that's appropriate, woof.
{character:???}Kekeke... It's fine. It's the quickest way to wake up this useless old man.
{character:???}Wake up, already, Washizu.
{character:Iwao Washizu}Ouch... Who...? Who is that...?
{character:???}Nyaa? I think his finger twitched a little? It looks like the young man is speaking the truth, nyaa.
{character:???}Well, that may be the case, but don't you think this is kind of too much, woof?
{character:Iwao Washizu}Who the hell has the audacity?!!!!
{character:Iwao Washizu}Beat it! Insolent lout! Who gave you permission to step on my head?!
{character:Shigeru Akagi}Kekeke... Look who finally decided to wake up! Washizu.
{character:Iwao Washizu}Akagi... Get down, you bastard! Who allowed you to stand above me?!
{character:Shigeru Akagi}Sorry for stepping on your table, my friends.
{character:Iwao Washizu}You should apologize to me, first! By the way... What in the world is this place? Since when did my mansion become such a pathetic shrine?
{character:Ichihime}What do you mean, "pathetic," nyaa?! How rude! One moment you barge into the living room, and the next, you're insulting the place, nyaa!
{character:Iwao Washizu}... Fine, these trivial matters are not important. Come on... Akagi, the winner has yet to be decided!
{character:Shigeru Akagi}Ah... I still don't know what's going on, but these things are certainly not important. Let's continue, Washizu, until one of us goes down.
{character:Iwao Washizu}Where did my subordinate and that dumb cop go? Fine, it's just between you and me, anyway. It doesn't matter who my partner is. Hey, cat demon, you got a mahjong table here?!
{character:Ichihime}Who are you calling a cat demon? Never mind the dumb dog, I'm an actual god, alright, nyaa?
{character:Wanjirou}Hey, that's my line, woof!
{character:Iwao Washizu}God? What a joke. No matter what god you are, you are still merely my servant! My slave!
{character:Shigeru Akagi} I agree. There's no way such a cute god would appear before you. The only god that will stand before you is the grim reaper.
{character:Iwao Washizu}Gahaha! What a joke, if anyone's going to meet the grim reaper, it's you! Akagi! Quick! You better find me a mahjong table, or I'll do it myself...
{character:Ichihime}Nyaa... What a capricious old man, nyaa.
{character:Wanjirou}The same goes for that young man. Stepping on someone's head as soon as they meet? That's going a little too far, no matter how much he may hate the old man, woof.
{character:Ichihime}What should we do, Wanjirou? They're getting away, nyaa.
{character:Wanjirou}We follow them, of course. Since when does a host let his guests run around as they please? Let's chase them, or we'll lose them for real...
